title: ResponseEnvelope
description: Response paired with one request identity.

AccessibilityElement.description: Normalized accessibility element from one immutable observation.

value.description: Non-sensitive display value when safely available.

large_change.description: Preferred large adjustment when the platform exposes one.

read_only.description: Whether the native provider reports the range as read-only.

small_change.description: Preferred small adjustment when the platform exposes one.
